<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeReport" name="Employee accident or safety report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport" name="Work accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport" name="Serious or fatal work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport" name="Self-employed person's work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport" name="School or education-provider accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Private insurance accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee accident and safety reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Accident, near accident, serious risk, or protection-system defect discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" name="Gather information about the incident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Capture the circumstances relevant to the accident and its possible coverage. Examples for insured gainful employment include an accident connected by location, time and cause to the employment; working from home; direct routes between residence, work, lunch, home, training or a doctor (where the doctor's visit was notified to the employer in advance); protected carpools; professional training; taking a supervised child to or from childcare, daycare, external care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, potentially covered work can also include qualifying household work, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, building work serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance. Accidents outside professional activity may also qualify in situations such as use of employment-service activities, assisting at an accident, donating blood, or specified activities with listed aid organisations. Record the applicable circumstances without assuming that coverage is established.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform the employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeReported" name="Employer informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emp_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emp_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emp_3" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerReport" name="Employee report received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" name="Determine applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious accident to the Labour Inspectorate immediately, if not reported to emergency services"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" name="Report qualifying work accident to the accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerInspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerInsurerReported" name="Accident insurance provider reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerNoExternalReport" name="No stated external reporting duty applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployerReport" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality or seriousInjury = true, and emergencyServicesHaveNotReported = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_4" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuredPersonKilled or unableToWorkForAtLeastThreeDays = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_5" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="End_EmployerNoExternalReport" name="Neither reporting condition applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="End_EmployerInspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_7" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="End_EmployerInsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person's accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Work accident involving the self-employed person or an employed person"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SelfEmployedReport" name="Report the accident to the accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReported" name="Accident insurance provider informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Self_1" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Self_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" targetRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Self_3" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student or schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Accident involving a student or schoolchild"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherStudentInformation" name="Gather information about the accident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Relevant circumstances can include a connection by location, time and cause to school, university or compulsory kindergarten education; a school or school-related event; the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; a prescribed practical task; or certain professional training orientations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StudentReport" name="Report the accident to the competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReported" name="Competent directorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_1" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherStudentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherStudentInformation" targetRef="Task_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_3" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="End_StudentReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EducationalInstitution" name="Educational institution accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EducationalAccident" name="Insured person physically injured or killed in a work accident"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" name="Gather information about the accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EducationalReport" name="Report the accident to the accident insurance provider in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EducationalReported" name="Accident insurance provider reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Edu_1" sourceRef="Start_EducationalAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Edu_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" targetRef="Task_EducationalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Edu_3" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="End_EducationalReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsured" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="Private-insured accident"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" name="Gather information about the accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Report the accident in writing immediately in line with the insurance conditions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Did the accident involve a fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report the fatality within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateReported" name="Private insurance reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_1" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_3" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_4" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_5" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateReported" name="No fatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_6" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="End_PrivateReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work accident reporting">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person" processRef="Process_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EducationalInstitution" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_EducationalInstitution"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured person" processRef="Process_PrivateInsured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate accident or safety report" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="Start_EmployerReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInsurer" name="Accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInspectorate" name="Fatal or serious accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToInsurer" name="Accident report" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate" name="Accident report" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EducationToInsurer" name="Report in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateImmediateToInsurer" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityToInsurer" name="Fatality report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_WorkAccident"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeIncidentReport" name="Employee incident or safety report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport" name="Qualifying work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport" name="Fatal or serious work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport" name="Self-employed person's work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EducationalInsuranceReport" name="Educational institution work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Immediate written private insurance accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee incident notification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Accident, near accident, serious risk, or protection-system defect discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" name="Gather accident and incident circumstances">
      <bpmn:documentation>Record relevant circumstances without assuming that coverage is established. For insured gainful employment, possible work-accident circumstances include a location, time and cause correlated to the employment; working from home; direct routes between permanent residence and work, to lunch or home (including protected carpools); professional training and direct routes to or from its centre; a direct route to a doctor and back that interrupts the route between residence and work or the route home, if the visit was notified to the employer in advance; taking a child for whom the person has supervisory responsibility to or from childcare, daycare, external care or school while travelling to or from work or a training centre; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, possible circumstances include a location, time and cause correlated to the insured education or compulsory kindergarten year; a school or school-related event; the direct route between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school and home; a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations. In an agricultural or forestry establishment, possible covered work can include household work serving the company to a considerable extent, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, building work serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Accidents outside professional activity can also be considered work accidents in connection with employment-service activities, assisting at an accident, donating blood, and training, exercises or service with the specified aid organisations: volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, and radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform the employer immediately of the accident, near accident, serious and immediate safety or health risk, or protection-system defect"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeReported" name="Employer informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_3" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerReport" name="Employee incident report received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeIncidentReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeIncidentReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" name="Gather information about the reported incident"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDuties" name="Determine which external reporting duties apply" default="Flow_Employer_NoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report a fatal or serious work accident to the Labour Inspectorate immediately if emergency services have not reported it"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" name="Report a work accident involving an insured person's death or an injury causing inability to work for three days, in full or in part, to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InsurerReported" name="Accident insurance provider reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoEmployerReport" name="No stated employer external-reporting duty applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployerReport" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatal or serious work accident and emergency services have not reported it</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_Insurer" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insured person killed or injured with inability to work for three days, in full or in part</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_NoReport" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="End_NoEmployerReport" name="Neither stated reporting condition applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_InspectorateEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="End_InspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_InsurerEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="End_InsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person's accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Work accident involving the self-employed person or a person they employ"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SelfEmployedReport" name="Report the accident involving the self-employed person or an employed person to the accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReported" name="Accident insurance provider informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_1" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" targetRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_3" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student or schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Accident involving a student or schoolchild"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherStudentInformation" name="Gather information about the accident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Record relevant circumstances without assuming that coverage is established. Possible work-accident circumstances include a location, time and cause correlated to the school or university education or compulsory kindergarten year forming the basis of insurance; participation in a school or school-related event; the direct route from the child's residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit and home; a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StudentReport" name="Report the accident to the competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReported" name="Competent directorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_1" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherStudentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherStudentInformation" targetRef="Task_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_3" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="End_StudentReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EducationalInstitution" name="Educational institution accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EducationalAccident" name="Work accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EducationalReport" name="Report every qualifying work accident to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate within a maximum of five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EducationalReported" name="Accident insurance provider reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Education_1" sourceRef="Start_EducationalAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Education_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" targetRef="Task_EducationalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Education_3" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="End_EducationalReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsured" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="Accident involving a privately insured person"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" name="Gather information about the accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Report the accident in writing to the private insurance provider immediately, in line with the conditions, to avoid release from the obligation to perform"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Did the accident involve a fatality?" default="Flow_Private_NoFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report the fatality to the private insurance provider within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateReported" name="Private insurance reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_1" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_3" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_NoFatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateReported" name="No fatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_FatalityEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="End_PrivateReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work accident reporting">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person" processRef="Process_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EducationalInstitution" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_EducationalInstitution"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured person" processRef="Process_PrivateInsured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate incident or safety report" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="Start_EmployerReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeIncidentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInsurer" name="Qualifying work accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInspectorate" name="Fatal or serious work accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToInsurer" name="Self-employed person's accident report" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate" name="Student or schoolchild accident report" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EducationToInsurer" name="Report in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_EducationalInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateImmediateToInsurer" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityToInsurer" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeIncidentReport" name="Immediate employee accident or safety report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInsurerReport" name="Employer report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport" name="Employer report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsurerReport" name="Self-employed person's report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentDirectorateReport" name="Student or schoolchild report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EducationInsurerReport" name="Educational institution's report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateAccidentReport" name="Written private-insurance accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private-insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee incident information and reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Work accident, near accident, serious immediate risk, or protection-system defect discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" name="Gather information about the incident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Record the circumstances without assuming that insurance coverage is established. For insured gainful employment, potentially relevant circumstances include a connection between the accident's location, time and cause and the insured employment; working from home; direct routes between residence and work, lunch, home or professional training, including protected carpools; a direct route to or from a doctor where the visit was notified to the employer in advance; taking a child for whom the person has supervisory responsibility to or from childcare, daycare, external care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. In agricultural or forestry establishments, depending on the protected group, potentially covered work can include work in the owner's or employee's household where it considerably serves the company, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, building work serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Accidents outside professional activity may also be covered in situations including use of services under unemployment or labour-market promotion legislation, assisting with an accident, donating blood, or training, exercises or service with the specified volunteer aid organisations: volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, and radiation detection and survey crews.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform the employer immediately of the accident, near accident, serious immediate risk, or protection-system defect"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeReported" name="Employer informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployeeInformation" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_3" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerReport" name="Employee incident report received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeIncidentReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeIncidentReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" name="Which external reporting duties apply?" default="Flow_Employer_NoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report a fatal or serious-injury work accident to the Labour Inspectorate immediately if emergency services have not reported it"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" name="Report within five days to the accident insurance provider if an insured person was killed or injured and unable to work for three days, wholly or partly"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerInspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate report sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerInsurerReported" name="Accident insurance provider report sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployerNoReport" name="No stated external reporting duty applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployerReport" targetRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEmployerInformation" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality or serious injury, and emergency services have not reported the accident</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_4" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insured person killed or unable to work for three days, wholly or partly</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_NoReport" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportingDuties" targetRef="End_EmployerNoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="End_EmployerInspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="End_EmployerInsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person's accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Work accident involving the self-employed person or a person they employ"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" name="Gather information about the work accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SelfEmployedReport" name="Report the accident to the accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReported" name="Accident insurance provider informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_1" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherSelfEmployedInformation" targetRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_3" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student or schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Accident involving a student or schoolchild"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherStudentInformation" name="Gather information about the accident">
      <bpmn:documentation>Potentially relevant circumstances for kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students include a connection between the accident's location, time and cause and the school, university or compulsory kindergarten education underlying the insurance; participation in a school or school-related event; the direct route between the child's residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or a school visit, or the way home; a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StudentReport" name="Report the accident to the competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReported" name="Competent directorate informed"/>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EducationalInstitution" name="School, educational facility or university accident reporting" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" name="Gather information about the accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EducationalReport" name="Report the work accident to the accident insurance provider in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EducationalReported" name="Accident insurance provider report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Education_1" sourceRef="Start_EducationalAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Education_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherEducationalInformation" targetRef="Task_EducationalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Education_3" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="End_EducationalReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsured" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" name="Gather information about the accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Report the accident in writing immediately in line with the private insurance conditions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Did the accident involve a fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report the fatality within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateReported" name="Private insurance reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_1" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_2" sourceRef="Task_GatherPrivateInformation" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_3" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_4" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_5" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateReported" name="No fatality">

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeReport" name="Immediate employee accident or safety report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport" name="Fatal or serious work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport" name="Qualifying work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport" name="Self-employed person's work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StudentDirectorateReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EducationInsuranceReport" name="School or educational institution work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateAccidentReport" name="Private insurance accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Gather accident information and inform the employer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Work accident, near accident, serious immediate risk, or protection-system defect discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordEmployeeIncident" name="Record the incident and relevant circumstances">
      <bpmn:documentation>For insured gainful employment, record whether the accident occurred at a location, time and for a cause connected with the insured employment; while working from home; on a direct route between the permanent residence and work, lunch or home, including in a carpool; during professional training or on the way to or from the training centre; or on a route to or from a doctor that interrupts the direct route between residence and work or the route home, where the doctor's visit was notified to the employer in advance. Also record whether it occurred on the way to or from work or a training centre while taking a child to or collecting a child from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility, or while making use of an advocacy group or professional association. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, relevant circumstances include a connection by location, time and cause to school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year; a school or school-related event; the direct route from the child's residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or school and home; a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; or certain professional training orientations. In an agricultural or forestry establishment, also record whether the activity involved household work serving the establishment to a considerable extent, accommodation for guests, secondary sales of agricultural products from the farm, building work serving the establishment, or neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Accidents outside professional activity may also arise in connection with services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act, assisting at an accident, donating blood, or training, exercises or service as a member of a listed aid organisation: Volunteer fire brigade, Volunteer water rescue service, Volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crews. Recording these circumstances does not determine whether insurance coverage applies.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform the employer immediately of the accident, near accident, serious immediate risk, or protection-system defect"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeReported" name="Employer informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_RecordEmployeeIncident"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordEmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_3" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employer" name="Employer reporting duties" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerReport" name="Employee incident report received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDuties" name="Which external reporting duties apply?" default="Flow_Employer_NoReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report a fatal or serious work accident to the Labour Inspectorate immediately if emergency services have not reported it"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" name="Report a work accident involving an insured person's death or at least three days of inability to work to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InsurerReported" name="Accident insurance provider informed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoEmployerReport" name="No stated external reporting duty applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployerReport" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatalityOrSeriousInjury = true and emergencyServicesHaveNotReported = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_Insurer" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuredPersonKilled = true or unableToWorkForAtLeastThreeDays = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_NoReport" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="End_NoEmployerReport" name="Neither stated reporting condition applies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_InspectorateEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="End_InspectorateReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employer_InsurerEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="End_InsurerReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person's accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Work accident involving the self-employed person or an employed person"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SelfEmployedReport" name="Report the accident to the accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SelfEmployedReported" name="Accident insurance provider informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_1" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_2" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="End_SelfEmployedReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student or schoolchild accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Accident involving a student or schoolchild"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StudentReport" name="Report the accident to the competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StudentReported" name="Competent directorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_1" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_StudentReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_2" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="End_StudentReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EducationalInstitution" name="Educational institution accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EducationalAccident" name="Insured person physically injured or killed in a work accident"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EducationalReport" name="Report the work accident to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EducationalReported" name="Accident insurance provider informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Educational_1" sourceRef="Start_EducationalAccident" targetRef="Task_EducationalReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Educational_2" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="End_EducationalReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PrivateInsured" name="Private insurance accident reporting" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccident" name="Accident involving a privately insured party"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Report the accident in writing immediately in line with the insurance conditions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Did the accident involve a fatality?" default="Flow_Private_NoFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report the fatality within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateReported" name="Private insurance reporting completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_1" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccident" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_2" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Fatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_NoFatality" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateReported" name="No fatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_3" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="End_PrivateReported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident" name="Work accident reporting">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer" processRef="Process_Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed person" processRef="Process_SelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student or schoolchild" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EducationalInstitution" name="School, educational facility or university" processRef="Process_EducationalInstitution"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsured" name="Privately insured person" processRef="Process_PrivateInsured"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate incident report" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="Start_EmployerReport" messageRef="Message_EmployeeReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInspectorate" name="Fatal or serious accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_EmployerInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerToInsurer" name="Qualifying work accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_EmployerInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToInsurer" name="Work accident report" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate" name="Student or schoolchild accident report" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_StudentDirectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EducationToInsurer" name="Report in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_EducationalReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_EducationInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateToInsurer" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateAccidentReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityToInsurer" name="Fatality report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant must send a report or other information to a recipient: model the reporting action itself as a send task when sending the information is the work being performed, rather than as a generic service task
rules.situation: the description states that a participant must send a report or other information to a recipient

rules.instruction: When the description gives an activity or decision a meaningful qualifier, such as its recipient, scope, timing, or eligibility criteria: Preserve meaningful qualifiers in the BPMN task label or gateway question; do not broaden or narrow the stated action or decision.
rules.situation: the description gives an activity or decision a meaningful qualifier, such as its recipient, scope, timing, or eligibility criteria
